summary.headline: Marcianus 366 and 594
summary.text: Catalogue entries for Marcianus 366 and Marcianus 594. They describe astrological materials including Persian eclipses and horoscopes, Autolycus on stellar risings, Critodemus and Vettius Valens on hostile places and aphesis, astronomical tables, Ps.-Ptolemy’s Centiloquium, and Ptolemy’s Quadripartitum and related works, alongside Herodotus, Julian, Cebes, and Leonardo Aretino.
